rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for monitoring a target over time or following it, including by its traces.

example.english: We will track this car's location.
example.traditional: 我哋會追蹤呢架車嘅位置。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zeoi1 zung1 ni1 gaa3 ce1 ge3 wai6 zi3

rows.note: Use this for the rails or track that trains run on.

example.english: This section of track needs repairs, so the trains can't run tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢段路軌要維修，聽日啲火車唔行得。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 lou6 gwai2 jiu3 wai4 sau1 ting1 jat6 di1 fo2 ce1 m4 haang4 dak1

rows.note: Use this as the casual way to refer to one song on an album.

example.english: My favorite track on the album is the first one.
example.traditional: 我最鍾意張碟入面第一首歌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zoeng1 dip6 jap6 min6 dai6 jat1 sau2 go1

rows.note: Use this for a track laid out for running or racing.

example.english: Please don't walk on the track.
example.traditional: 你哋唔好喺跑道上面行呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 hai2 paau2 dou6 soeng6 min6 haang4 aa3

rows.note: Use this for something physically moving along a route or in a particular direction.

example.english: The arrow will track along the line.
example.traditional: 個箭頭會沿住條線移動。
example.jyutping: go3 zin3 tau4 wui5 jyun4 zyu6 tiu4 sin3 ji4 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a visible trace left behind, including a footprint or animal track when the specific footprint is not being emphasised.

example.english: There is still a track left by an animal in the snow.
example.traditional: 雪地上仲有一條動物留低嘅痕跡。
example.jyutping: syut3 dei6 soeng6 zung6 jau5 jat1 tiu4 dung6 mat6 lau4 dai1 ge3 han4 zik1

rows.note: Use this when something physically leaves a visible mark or trail, rather than when someone follows a trail.

example.english: The wet shoes left a track on the wooden floor.
example.traditional: 濕鞋踩過木地板，留低咗一條痕。
example.jyutping: sap1 haai4 caai2 gwo3 muk6 dei6 baan2 lau4 dai1 zo2 jat1 tiu4 han4

rows.note: Use this when facts or information are consistent and make sense together.

example.english: The timing seems to track with the record.
example.traditional: 呢個時間同記錄對得上。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan1 tung4 gei3 luk6 deoi3 dak1 soeng6
